tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec113/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && P=plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts; R=eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json; python3 -B $P/aggregate-completeness.py --report "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$R" --spec-dir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/system-spec" > "$TMPDIR/agg.json"; echo agg_exit=$?; head -c 600 "$TMPDIR/agg.json"; echo; shasum -a 256 $R; python3 -c '
import json
r=json.load(open("eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json"))
print("verdict",r["verdict"],"spec_dir",r["spec_dir"])
print({k:v["verdict"] for k,v in r["aspects"].items()})
for d in r["audit_delegations"]: print(d["aspect"],d["role"],d["auditor"],d["verdict"],d["dispatch"].get("session_id"),d["dispatch"].get("tool_use_id"))
print("gates",[(g["id"],g["exit_code"]) for g in r["gate_results"]])
print("high",[f for f in r["findings"] if f["severity"]=="high"],"gaps",r["gaps"])
import hashlib,pathlib
snap=r["artifact_snapshot"]["artifacts"]
bad=[p for p,h in snap.items() if hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h.replace("sha256:","")]
print("snapshot entries",len(snap),"mismatch",bad)
print("index digest in snapshot",snap.get("system-spec/index.md"))
'; python3 -c '
import json
for l in open("eval-log/system-spec-harness/audit-fork-ledger.jsonl"):
    j=json.loads(l); print(j.get("schema_version"),j.get("subagent_type"),j.get("verdict_state"),j.get("audit_verdict"),j.get("tool_use_id"))'
